en.headline: Wang Fuk Court fire independent committee report delayed to end of October
en.dek: The Chief Executive has approved an extension so the panel can analyse more than one million files and complete its findings and recommendations.
body: The independent committee examining the Wang Fuk Court fire in Tai Po has been granted approval by the Chief Executive to submit its report by the end of October, later than the original nine-month target.

The committee said it is processing written evidence and other materials received, including more than one million files, and has begun drafting the report. It noted that the matters under its terms of reference are numerous and complex, involving many parties, and that it needs additional time to analyse the large volume of information on a factual basis before reaching conclusions and making recommendations.

The committee was established in December 2025 and formally began work on 19 December. It held 30 hearing sessions between March and July 2026. It said it would continue to discharge its duties fairly, openly and impartially while reviewing every submission.

zh.headline: 宏福苑火災獨立委員會報告延至十月底提交
zh.dek: 行政長官已同意延期，委員會指需時分析逾百萬個檔案及各方資料後才完成研判及建議。
body: 大埔宏福苑火災獨立委員會獲行政長官同意，將提交報告期限延至十月底，較原定九個月目標為遲。
委員會表示，現正處理書面證供及其他陸續收到的資料，包括超過一百萬個檔案，並已開始草擬報告。職權範圍涵蓋事項繁多且性質複雜、涉事方眾多，須以事實為基礎作出研判、結論及建議，因此需要較多時間分析大量資料。
委員會於2025年12月成立，12月19日正式展開工作，今年3月至7月舉行了30場聽證會。委員會強調會繼續按公平、公開和不偏不倚原則履行職責，細心審視各方提交的每一項資料。
